name: na-engineering-required-input-form
description: Collect required NA Engineering skill inputs in a Codex form.

interface.shortDescription: Collect skill inputs in a Codex form.
interface.longDescription: Shows non-sensitive required inputs in a Codex form before a NA Engineering skill starts. The service does not store submitted values.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the NA Engineering Required Input Form to collect missing skill inputs.
